clause: DESIGN R3.3 §9.3 Per-notion style, text and glyph contracts
witness: corner-fold size roundEven(min(w,h)*foldRatio) and its three-point path
derivation: foldRatio 0.1 is the rational 1/10 (shortest decimal form): 5 x 1/10 = 0.5, tie to even 0 (the exact binary64 value of 0.1 would round to 1); path (x+w-fold,y),(x+w-fold,y+fold),(x+w,y+fold) gives the listed points.
